flow.name: 04 · Interval heartbeat (HTTP GET + active window)
flow.notes: Every 15 minutes during waking hours (08:00–22:00), pings httpbin.org and posts the resulting HTTP status. Tests Interval trigger (≥15min → WorkManager-backed), activeWindow, HTTP GET, storeStatusInVar, retries, and trigger.firedAtMillis magic-text. Tip: for testing, drop intervalMinutes to 1 in the editor — that switches the engine to AlarmManager.setRepeating which is throttle-prone on some OEMs but fine for a quick demo.
